headline: SIMULATION: US nuclear strike on Iran; Hormuz closed and Australian fuel security measures activated.
summary: THIS IS A SIMULATION - NOTHING HAS HAPPENED. In this scenario a US nuclear strike on Iran has triggered a regional war and closed the Strait of Hormuz. There is no fallout risk to SA, but Australia's imported fuel supply is directly hit and the government has activated emergency fuel measures.
actions: Fill the car and fuel cans now, before queues build
Buy two weeks of food, water and medicines
Check in with family and agree when to meet
